EZ TV Admin Panel

Manage guides, apps, updates and community posts. Changes save to this browser only until exported.

Security note: This admin area is protected by a local PIN stored only in your browser, suitable for a single trusted operator on a personal device. It is not a secure multi-user login system. For a public production deployment, replace this with real server-side authentication before storing anything sensitive.

To publish your content so every visitor sees it:
  1. Click Download JSON below — it saves as content.json.
  2. Upload that content.json file into the same GitHub folder as this HTML file (same repo, same location — replacing the old content.json if one exists).
  3. Commit the change. No need to touch the HTML file itself.
  4. Visit your live GitHub Pages link — it will now show this content automatically.
This only works on the real published site (GitHub Pages), not when double-clicking the HTML file on your own computer — local files can't load content.json due to normal browser security. Editing content here in the admin panel always previews instantly in this browser either way.
